issue.title: Launch-time prettier pass rewrites paired __ tokens to ** in agent prompts, corrupting paths and labels

task_type_fields.impact: Every agent whose prompt has two `__` tokens in one paragraph outside code spans gets silently altered paths, labels, and identifiers. That covers user prose naming files like `x__cdx.md`, and paths under `gh_sase-org__sase`. #research_swarm leads and linkers receive labels and paths that do not exist; the linker's strict "label of the form <name>__final.md" check can fail on them.
task_type_fields.repro:
Launch preprocessing (`preprocess_prompt_late` / step 6 in `src/sase/llm_provider/preprocessing.py`) runs `format_agent_prompt_markdown` (prettier) AFTER top-level Jinja (step 5). Prettier treats a paragraph containing two `__` tokens as `__strong__` emphasis and normalizes it to `**`. `_unescape_prettier_underscores` in `src/sase/file_references.py` only repairs the single-token `\_\_` escape, not this rewrite.

Repro (prettier 3.8.1, the same tool the launch path shells out to):

    printf 'Compare topic__cdx.md with topic__cld.md.\n\nPath /x/gh_sase-org__sase/a__cdx.md\n' > /tmp/pt.md
    prettier --parser markdown /tmp/pt.md
    # -> Compare topic**cdx.md with topic**cld.md.
    # -> Path /x/gh_sase-org**sase/a**cdx.md

Observed in production: research.34.final's rendered prompt (`~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run/202610/01/20261001102718/workflow-*-main_prompt.md`) lists `label=research:202610/master_ci_failure_accumulation**cdx.md` and `path=/home/bryan/.sase/artifacts/agents/gh_sase-org**sase/...`. A run-archive scan found the same corruption in all 39 #research_swarm lead prompts and all 4 linker prompts since 2026-09-21. Text inside inline code spans is not rewritten (verified), so a plugin-side workaround is to backtick the `wait.artifacts` fields.

Fix direction: stop launch-time formatting from rewriting emphasis in agent prompts. For example, format only the authored text before runtime Jinja fills in machine values, protect `__…__` spans the way fenced blocks are protected, or keep prettier as an editor-only action.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching #research_swarm improvements: every recent research lead and linker prompt received corrupted wait.artifacts labels and paths, and the root cause is general to all agent prompts.

evidence.note: Independent repro by research.37.final: ran the repo's own format_agent_prompt_markdown (sase a176e70328, prettier 3.8.1) on a wait.artifacts-style list; label=research:202610/topic__cdx.md became topic**cdx.md and gh_sase-org__sase became gh_sase-org**sase, while backtick-wrapped fields passed through unchanged. Also observed live in research.37.final's own launch prompt (labels research:202610/research_swarm_evidence_quality_and_orchestration**cdx.md and path .../gh_sase-org**sase/...). Consolidated analysis: research:202610/research_swarm_improvement_roadmap/research_swarm_improvement_roadmap__final.md
